Site URL: The original web address submitted for analysis.
site_id: The position of the website in the input list, used to track domain redirects.
status: Shows whether the website was successfully scanned during the crawl.
domain: The actual domain name analyzed after following any web redirects.
sent_gpc: Shows whether the extension sent an automated Global Privacy Control (GPC) opt-out signal.
gpp_version: The version of the Global Privacy Platform API used by the site to manage privacy choices.
uspapi_before_gpc: The US Privacy String returned by calling the site's JavaScript API (USPAPI) before sending GPC.
uspapi_after_gpc: The US Privacy String returned by calling the site's JavaScript API (USPAPI) after sending GPC.
usp_cookies_before_gpc: The US Privacy String stored in browser HTTP cookies before sending GPC.
usp_cookies_after_gpc: The US Privacy String stored in browser HTTP cookies after sending GPC.
OptanonConsent_before_gpc: The OneTrust cookie consent setting (specifically checking 'isGpcEnabled') before sending GPC.
OptanonConsent_after_gpc: The OneTrust cookie consent setting (specifically checking 'isGpcEnabled') after sending GPC.
gpp_before_gpc: The raw Global Privacy Platform (GPP) string detected before sending GPC.
gpp_after_gpc: The raw Global Privacy Platform (GPP) string detected after sending GPC.
urlClassification: Tracker categories detected by Firefox on the page (such as advertising, social, or fingerprinting scripts).
OneTrustWPCCPAGoogleOptOut_before_gpc: The value of OneTrust's CCPA/Google opt-out cookie before sending GPC.
OneTrustWPCCPAGoogleOptOut_after_gpc: The value of OneTrust's CCPA/Google opt-out cookie after sending GPC.
OTGPPConsent_before_gpc: The value of OneTrust's Global Privacy Platform consent cookie before sending GPC.
OTGPPConsent_after_gpc: The value of OneTrust's Global Privacy Platform consent cookie after sending GPC.
usps_before_gpc: The US Privacy String recorded before sending GPC.
usps_after_gpc: The US Privacy String recorded after sending GPC to confirm if an opt-out occurred.
decoded_gpp_before_gpc: A human-readable breakdown of Global Privacy Platform choices before sending GPC.
decoded_gpp_after_gpc: A human-readable breakdown of Global Privacy Platform choices after sending GPC.
USPS implementation: How the site stores US Privacy String choices (via JavaScript API, cookies, or both).
error: Technical errors encountered while visiting the site (such as connection timeouts).
Well-known: Indicates whether the site publishes an official privacy signal policy file.
compliance_result: Overall result showing whether a site honors privacy signals across all checked frameworks.
compliance_classification: Breakdown of site compliance according to each specific method of possible opt outs (e.g., USPS, OptanonConsent Cookie, or GPP SaleOptOut field).
site_isnull: A boolean indicating if a site has no privacy strings, cookies, or GPP data detected before or after sending a GPC signal.
reasons_non_compliant: Specific reasons why the site was evaluated as non-compliant after receiving GPC.
Tranco: Website popularity ranking based on global web traffic (lower numbers indicate higher traffic).
third_party_count: Total count of external third-party domains loaded by the website.
third_party_urls: List of external web addresses loaded on the page.
unique_ad_networks: Names of distinct advertising networks detected on the page.
num_unique_ad_networks: Total number of distinct advertising networks found on the site.
